Tanya Gupta — tanya.gupta191@example.com — +91 9223738354
Hinjewadi, Pune
Detail-oriented Java developer focused on building reliable backend services. Notice period: 60 days.

Java Developer, Ola — Oct 2025 - Present
Built and maintained ride-matching and pricing backend services. Implemented resilient Microservices using Spring Boot that processed trip requests with sub-200ms latency under typical load. Designed MySQL schemas and optimized queries to reduce average DB response time by 30%. Integrated Apache Kafka for event-driven communication between services, improving end-to-end data propagation and enabling near-real-time analytics. Instrumented services with CloudWatch to monitor latency and error rates and set alarms for critical thresholds. Implemented asynchronous processing with SQS for non-blocking tasks and used S3 for storing trip snapshots and logs. Wrote unit and integration tests with JUnit and enforced CI practices with Git. Tracked work and coordinated in an Agile workflow using Jira.

Skills: Java, SpringBoot, Microservices, MySQL, Apache Kafka, CloudWatch, SQS, S3, JUnit, Jira, Git, Agile

Education: M.Tech, Data Science, IIIT Hyderabad
